name: Exquisite sculpture
name_th: ประติมากรรมสุดประณีต
desc: A delicate statue has fallen to the ground, revealing a faint golden light within.
desc_vn: Một bức tượng tinh xảo bị ngã xuống đất, dường như có thể thấy ánh sáng vàng lấp lánh bên trong.
desc_en: A delicate statue has fallen to the ground, revealing a faint golden light within.
desc_th: รูปปั้นที่ประณีตล้มลงกับพื้น ดูเหมือนจะมีแสงสีทองเปล่งประกายอยู่ภายใน
desc_in: Sebuah patung indah jatuh ke tanah, tampak cahaya keemasan di dalamnya.
desc_ph: Isang maselang estatwa ang bumagsak sa lupa, tila may kumikislap na gintong liwanag sa loob.
desc_ma: Sebuah arca halus terjatuh ke tanah, tampak cahaya keemasan di dalamnya.
choice1_th: สร้างรูปปั้นขึ้นใหม่
resultDesc1: Received a blessing from the statue, the deployed heroes’ HP was fully restored
resultDesc1_vn: Nhận được phúc lành từ bức tượng, HP của các anh hùng ra trận được hồi phục hoàn toàn
resultDesc1_en: Received a blessing from the statue, the deployed heroes’ HP was fully restored
resultDesc1_th: ได้รับพรจากรูปปั้น HP ของฮีโร่ที่ส่งลงสู่สนามฟื้นเต็ม
resultDesc1_in: Menerima berkat dari patung, HP semua hero yang diturunkan pulih sepenuhnya
resultDesc1_ph: Nakatanggap ng biyaya mula sa estatwa, lubos na bumalik ang HP ng lahat ng bayani na ipinadala sa laban
resultDesc1_ma: Menerima berkat dari patung, HP semua hero yang dikerahkan dipulihkan sepenuhnya
choice2_th: ทำลายมัน
resultDesc2: Received gold but cursed, all deployed heroes lose 20% HP
resultDesc2_vn: Nhận được vàng nhưng bị nguyền rủa, tất cả anh hùng ra trận bị giảm 20% HP
resultDesc2_en: Received gold but cursed, all deployed heroes lose 20% HP
resultDesc2_th: ได้รับทองแต่ถูกสาป ฮีโร่ที่ส่งลงสู่สนามทั้งหมดเสีย HP 20%
resultDesc2_in: Menerima emas tetapi dikutuk, semua hero kehilangan 20% HP
resultDesc2_ph: Pumasa ka ng ginto ngunit sinumpa, lahat ng bayani mawalan ng 20% HP
resultDesc2_ma: Menerima emas tetapi dikutuk, semua wira kehilangan 20% HP
choice3_th: แกล้งทำเป็นไม่เห็น
resultDesc3: Nothing happened
resultDesc3_vn: Không có chuyện gì xảy ra
resultDesc3_en: Nothing happened

resultDesc3_in: Tidak ada yang terjadi

resultDesc3_ma: Tiada apa yang berlaku

name: Strange sculpture
name_th: ประติมากรรมแปลกประหลาด
desc: A strange statue has fallen to the ground, revealing a blinding light inside.
desc_vn: Một bức tượng kỳ lạ bị ngã xuống đất, dường như có thể thấy ánh sáng chói lóa bên trong.
desc_en: A strange statue has fallen to the ground, revealing a blinding light inside.
desc_th: รูปปั้นประหลาดล้มลงกับพื้น ดูเหมือนจะมีแสงเจิดจ้าอยู่ภายใน
desc_in: Sebuah patung aneh jatuh ke tanah, tampak cahaya terang menyala di dalamnya.
desc_ph: Isang kakaibang estatwa ang bumagsak, tila may nakakasilaw na liwanag sa loob.
desc_ma: Sebuah arca pelik terjatuh ke tanah, tampak cahaya terang menyinar di dalamnya.
choice1_th: สร้างรูปปั้นขึ้นใหม่
resultDesc1: Received a blessing from the statue, the deployed heroes’ Rage was fully restored
resultDesc1_vn: Nhận được phúc lành từ bức tượng, nộ khí của các anh hùng ra trận được hồi phục hoàn toàn
resultDesc1_en: Received a blessing from the statue, the deployed heroes’ Rage was fully restored
resultDesc1_th: ได้รับพรจากรูปปั้น โกรธของฮีโร่ที่ส่งลงสู่สนามฟื้นเต็ม
resultDesc1_in: Menerima berkat dari patung, Rage semua hero yang diturunkan pulih sepenuhnya
resultDesc1_ph: Nakatanggap ng biyaya mula sa estatwa, lubos na bumalik ang Rage ng lahat ng bayani na ipinadala sa laban
resultDesc1_ma: Menerima berkat dari patung, Rage semua hero yang dikerahkan dipulihkan sepenuhnya
choice2_th: ทำลายมัน
resultDesc2: Received gold but cursed, all deployed heroes’ Rage is wiped
resultDesc2_vn: Nhận được vàng nhưng bị nguyền rủa, toàn bộ nộ khí của anh hùng ra trận bị xóa sạch
resultDesc2_en: Received gold but cursed, all deployed heroes’ Rage is wiped
resultDesc2_th: ได้รับทองแต่ถูกสาป โทสะของฮีโร่ถูกล้างหมด
resultDesc2_in: Menerima emas tetapi dikutuk, semua Rage hero dihapus
resultDesc2_ph: Pumasa ka ng ginto ngunit sinumpa, ang lahat ng Rage ng bayani ay natanggal
resultDesc2_ma: Menerima emas tetapi dikutuk, semua Rage wira dihapus
choice3_th: แกล้งทำเป็นไม่เห็น
resultDesc3: A faint light flickered from the statue and enveloped you. It seems you've received a blessing. In the next battle, whenever an allied hero defeats an enemy, they will gain a 100% attack buff that lasts for 2 turns.
resultDesc3_vn: Một tia sáng yếu lóe lên từ trong bức tượng, bao phủ lên bạn, dường như bạn đã nhận được lời chúc phúc. Trong trận chiến tiếp theo, anh hùng phe ta sau khi tiêu diệt kẻ địch sẽ nhận được 100% buff sức tấn công, kéo dài 2 hiệp.
resultDesc3_en: A faint light flickered from the statue and enveloped you. It seems you've received a blessing. In the next battle, whenever an allied hero defeats an enemy, they will gain a 100% attack buff that lasts for 2 turns.
resultDesc3_th: แสงสลัวแวบขึ้นจากรูปปั้นและห่อหุ้มตัวคุณไว้ ดูเหมือนว่าคุณได้รับพรแล้ว ในการต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไป ฮีโร่ฝ่ายเราที่สังหารศัตรูจะได้รับบัฟโจมตีเพิ่ม 100% นาน 2 เทิร์น
resultDesc3_in: Cahaya redup berkedip dari patung dan menyelimuti kamu. Sepertinya kamu telah menerima berkah. Dalam pertempuran berikutnya, setiap kali hero sekutu mengalahkan musuh, mereka akan mendapatkan buff serangan 100% selama 2 giliran.
resultDesc3_ph: Isang mahinang liwanag ang kumislap mula sa rebulto at bumalot sa iyo. Mukhang nakatanggap ka ng basbas. Sa susunod na laban, kapag nakapatay ng kalaban ang bayani ng ating koponan, makakakuha siya ng 100% dagdag lakas sa loob ng 2 turn.
resultDesc3_ma: Sinar cahaya samar terpancar dari patung dan menyelubungi anda. Nampaknya anda telah menerima berkat. Dalam pertempuran seterusnya, setiap kali wira pasukan kita menewaskan musuh, mereka akan menerima peningkatan serangan 100% selama 2 pusingan.

name: Monster blocking the way
name_th: สัตว์ประหลาดขวางทาง
desc: You accidentally awaken a sleeping wild beast.
desc_vn: Bạn vô tình đánh thức một con quái thú hoang dã đang ngủ say.
desc_en: You accidentally awaken a sleeping wild beast.
desc_th: คุณเผลอปลุกสัตว์ร้ายป่าที่กำลังหลับใหล
desc_in: Kamu tidak sengaja membangunkan monster buas yang sedang tidur.
desc_ph: Aksidenteng nagising mo ang isang mabangis na halimaw.
desc_ma: Kamu secara tidak sengaja membangunkan raksasa buas yang sedang tidur.
choice1_th: ปลอบเขา
resultDesc1: The beast continues sleeping soundly, and there seems to be a treasure chest behind it
resultDesc1_vn: Quái thú tiếp tục ngủ say, phía sau nó dường như có một rương báu
resultDesc1_en: The beast continues sleeping soundly, and there seems to be a treasure chest behind it
resultDesc1_th: สัตว์ร้ายยังคงหลับสนิท ดูเหมือนว่ามีหีบสมบัติอยู่ข้างหลัง
resultDesc1_in: Raksasa itu terus tidur nyenyak, dan tampaknya ada peti harta dibelakangnya
resultDesc1_ph: Patuloy na natutulog ang halimaw, at tila may treasure chest sa likuran
resultDesc1_ma: Raksasa itu terus tidur nyenyak, dan sepertinya ada peti harta di belakangnya
choice2_th: ซ่อนตัว
resultDesc2: The beast roars in anger, you panic—physical and special attack down 10%, deployed heroes’ Rage decreases
resultDesc2_vn: Quái thú nổi giận gầm thét, bạn hoảng sợ—sức tấn công vật lý và đặc biệt giảm 10%, nộ khí của anh hùng ra trận bị giảm
resultDesc2_en: The beast roars in anger, you panic—physical and special attack down 10%, deployed heroes’ Rage decreases
resultDesc2_th: สัตว์ร้ายคำรามด้วยความโกรธ คุณตกใจ—พลังโจมตีปกติและพิเศษลดลง 10%, โทสะของฮีโร่ลดลง
resultDesc2_in: Raksasa mengamuk dan menggeram, kamu panik—serangan fisik & khusus turun 10%, Rage hero menurun
resultDesc2_ph: Galit na umungol ang halimaw, natakot ka—pisikal & espesyal na atake bumaba ng 10%, Rage ng bayani bumaba
resultDesc2_ma: Naga Nether mengamuk, kamu panik—serangan fizikal & khas turun 10%, Rage wira berkurang

name: Contains a mystery
name_th: ซ่อนความลับไว้
desc: This place is empty, but you can hear a faint sound.
desc_vn: Nơi này trống rỗng, dường như có thể nghe thấy âm thanh yếu ớt.
desc_en: This place is empty, but you can hear a faint sound.
desc_th: สถานที่แห่งนี้ว่างเปล่า แต่ดูเหมือนจะได้ยินเสียงเบาๆ

choice1_th: ฟัง

resultDesc1_vn: Nghe thấy giọng hát của Meloetta, trong trận chiến tiếp theo, anh hùng hành động đầu tiên của phe ta sẽ gây sát thương gấp đôi
resultDesc1_en: Heard Meloetta’s voice— in the next battle, our first acting hero will deal double damage
resultDesc1_th: ได้ยินเสียง Meloetta—ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไป ฮีโร่คนแรกของเราจะสร้างความเสียหายเป็นสองเท่า
resultDesc1_in: Mendengar suara Meloetta—dalam pertarungan berikutnya, hero pertama kita akan memberikan kerusakan dua kali lipat
resultDesc1_ph: Narinig ang boses ni Meloetta—sa susunod na laban, ang unang bayani ng ating panig ay magbibigay ng dobleng pinsala
resultDesc1_ma: Mendengar suara Meloetta—dalam pertempuran berikutnya, hero pertama kita akan memberikan kerusakan dua kali lipat
choice2_th: ค้นหาบริเวณรอบ ๆ
resultDesc2: It seems a treasure chest was found, inside are some items
resultDesc2_vn: Hình như phát hiện một rương báu, bên trong có một vài món đồ
resultDesc2_en: It seems a treasure chest was found, inside are some items
resultDesc2_th: ดูเหมือนพบหีบสมบัติ ข้างในมีของบางอย่าง
resultDesc2_in: Sepertinya menemukan peti harta, di dalamnya ada beberapa item
resultDesc2_ph: Mukhang may nahanap na treasure chest, may ilang item sa loob
resultDesc2_ma: Nampaknya menemui peti harta, dalamnya ada beberapa item

desc_in: Tiga anggota Aliansi Penjahat ditemukan sedang menyelinap.

choice1_th: เดินเข้าไปทัก
resultDesc1: The trio panicked and an immediate battle ensued— the deployed heroes’ HP decreased by 10%, but Rage increased

resultDesc2_en: They seemed to find something valuable and left; you follow the trail and also pick up some remaining gold, +15000 gold

name: Mysterious person
name_th: บุคคลลึกลับ
desc: You unexpectedly meet a suspicious person and strike up a conversation.
desc_vn: Bất ngờ gặp một người có hành tung đáng ngờ, bạn bắt chuyện với anh ta.
desc_en: You unexpectedly meet a suspicious person and strike up a conversation.
desc_th: เจอบุคคลที่ดูน่าสงสัยโดยบังเอิญ และคุณเริ่มพูดคุยกับเขา
desc_in: Kamu bertemu seseorang yang mencurigakan dan mulai berbicara dengannya.
desc_ph: Biglang may nakilala kang kahina-hinalang tao at kinausap mo siya.
desc_ma: Kamu bertemu orang yang mencurigakan dan berbual dengannya.
choice1_th: คุณคือใคร
resultDesc1: The mysterious person revealed their true identity as an explorer, took out a gemstone from the bag, after you received it you were blessed— in the next battle, our heroes start with 1000 Rage
resultDesc1_vn: Người bí ẩn tiết lộ thân phận thật là một nhà thám hiểm, lấy ra một viên đá quý từ túi, sau khi bạn nhận lấy, được ban phúc lành—trong trận chiến tiếp theo, các anh hùng phe ta nhận được 1000 nộ khí khởi đầu
resultDesc1_en: The mysterious person revealed their true identity as an explorer, took out a gemstone from the bag, after you received it you were blessed— in the next battle, our heroes start with 1000 Rage
resultDesc1_th: บุคคลลึกลับเปิดเผยตัวว่าเป็นนักสำรวจ นำอัญมณีออกจากถุง หลังจากคุณได้รับพร—ในการต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไป ฮีโร่ของเราจะเริ่มด้วยโกรธ 1000
resultDesc1_in: Orang misterius mengungkapkan dirinya sebagai penjelajah, mengeluarkan batu permata dari tas, setelah Anda menerimanya Anda diberkati—dalam pertarungan berikutnya, hero kita memulai dengan 1000 Rage
resultDesc1_ph: Inihayag ng misteryosong tao na siya ay isang explorer, kumuha ng gemstone mula sa bag, pagkatapos mong matanggap ito ay pinabanal ka—sa susunod na laban, magsisimula ang mga bayani natin na may 1000 Rage
resultDesc1_ma: Orang misteri mendedahkan dirinya sebagai pengembara, mengambil batu permata dari beg, selepas anda menerimanya anda diberkati—dalam pertempuran berikutnya, hero kita bermula dengan 1000 Rage
choice2_th: คุณมาจากไหน
resultDesc2: The mysterious person points to a direction; following it you find a strange device—after activating, you receive 200 bonus points
resultDesc2_vn: Người bí ẩn chỉ về một hướng, đi theo hướng đó bạn phát hiện một thiết bị kỳ lạ—kích hoạt xong, nhận được 200 điểm thưởng
resultDesc2_en: The mysterious person points to a direction; following it you find a strange device—after activating, you receive 200 bonus points
resultDesc2_th: บุคคลลึกลับชี้ไปทางหนึ่ง คุณตามและเจออุปกรณ์แปลกๆ—หลังเปิดใช้งาน ได้รับ 200 คะแนนโบนัส
resultDesc2_in: Orang misterius menunjuk satu arah; mengikutinya kamu menemukan perangkat aneh—setelah aktif, kamu menerima 200 poin bonus
resultDesc2_ph: Ang misteryosong tao ay tumuro sa isang direksyon; tinungo mo ito at nahanap ang kakaibang device—pag-activate, nakatanggap ka ng 200 bonus puntos
resultDesc2_ma: Orang misteri menunjuk satu arah; ikutnya kamu jumpa alat pelik—selepas aktif, kamu terima 200 mata bonus
choice3_th: คุณจะไปที่ไหน
resultDesc3: The mysterious person seems unwilling to say anything, taking out a small pouch from their bag and giving it to you (received a small reward)
resultDesc3_vn: Người bí ẩn dường như không muốn nói gì, lấy ra một túi nhỏ từ trong túi đưa cho bạn (nhận được một phần thưởng nhỏ)
resultDesc3_en: The mysterious person seems unwilling to say anything, taking out a small pouch from their bag and giving it to you (received a small reward)
resultDesc3_th: บุคคลปริศนาดูเหมือนไม่ต้องการพูดอะไร หยิบถุงเล็กๆ ออกจากกระเป๋าแล้วให้กับคุณ (ได้รับรางวัลเล็กๆ)
resultDesc3_in: Orang misterius tampaknya tidak ingin mengatakan apa-apa, mengeluarkan sebuah kantong kecil dari tasnya dan memberikannya kepada Anda (menerima hadiah kecil)
resultDesc3_ph: Ang taong misteryoso ay tila ayaw magsalita, kumuha ng maliit na supot mula sa bag at ibinigay sa iyo (nakatanggap ng maliit na gantimpala)
resultDesc3_ma: Orang misteri nampaknya tidak mahu berkata apa-apa, mengeluarkan satu beg kecil dari dalam beg dan memberikannya kepada anda (menerima ganjaran kecil)

resultDesc3_en: The genie said your wish was unreasonable, nothing happened... ..................but, it seems to have left some gold behind
resultDesc3_th: จินนี่บอกว่าคำขอของคุณไม่สมเหตุสมผล ไม่มีอะไรเกิดขึ้น... ..................แต่ ดูเหมือนว่าจะทิ้งทองไว้บ้าง

resultDesc3_ma: Jin berkata permintaan anda tidak munasabah, tiada apa yang berlaku... ..................tetapi, nampaknya masih meninggalkan sedikit emas

desc: The Hero King, glowing with golden light, appears—a symbol of prestige who may bless you.
desc_vn: Vị Vua Anh Hùng lấp lánh ánh vàng đã xuất hiện, đó là vị anh hùng tượng trưng cho sự đẳng cấp, dường như có thể ban phúc cho bạn.
desc_en: The Hero King, glowing with golden light, appears—a symbol of prestige who may bless you.
desc_th: ราชาวีรบุรุษที่ส่องแสงสีทองปรากฏตัว เป็นสัญลักษณ์ของเกียรติยศ ดูเหมือนจะอวยพรให้คุณ
desc_in: Raja Pahlawan yang bersinar emas muncul, simbol kehormatan yang mungkin memberkatimu.
desc_ph: Ang Hari ng mga Bayani na may gintong liwanag ay dumating—isang sagisag ng dangal na maaaring magbigay ng biyaya.
desc_ma: Raja Wira bersinar emas muncul—simbol kemuliaan, mungkin memberkati kamu.
choice1: My damage isn’t enough, need a boost
choice1_vn: Sát thương của tôi không đủ, cần tăng cường
choice1_en: My damage isn’t enough, need a boost
choice1_th: พลังโจมตีไม่พอ ต้องเสริม
choice1_ph: Hindi sapat ang pinsala ko, kailangan ng lakas
choice1_ma: Serangan saya tidak cukup, perlu ditingkatkan
resultDesc1: Received a damage-increase blessing— at the end of each round, all enemies take pure damage equal to 20% of the strongest hero’s ATK
resultDesc1_vn: Nhận được phúc lành gia tăng sát thương—mỗi khi kết thúc đại hiệp, toàn bộ kẻ địch sẽ chịu sát thương chuẩn bằng 20% công của anh hùng phe ta có sức tấn công cao nhất
resultDesc1_en: Received a damage-increase blessing— at the end of each round, all enemies take pure damage equal to 20% of the strongest hero’s ATK
resultDesc1_th: ได้รับพรแรงโจมตี—เมื่อสิ้นสุดแต่ละรอบ ศัตรูทั้งหมดจะได้รับความเสียหายสุทธิเทียบเท่า 20% ของพลังโจมตีฮีโร่ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุด
resultDesc1_in: Menerima berkat peningkatan kerusakan—setelah setiap ronde, semua musuh menerima damage murni sebesar 20% dari ATK hero terkuat
resultDesc1_ph: Nakatanggap ka ng blessing na nagdagdag ng damage—sa pagtatapos ng bawat round, lahat ng kalaban ay tumatanggap ng pure damage na katumbas ng 20% ng pinakamalakas na ATK ng ating bayani
resultDesc1_ma: Menerima berkat peningkatan kerosakan—selepas setiap pusingan, semua musuh menerima damage tulen sebanyak 20% daripada ATK hero terkuat
choice2: My hero is easily defeated, need to boost survivability
choice2_vn: Anh hùng của tôi dễ bị hạ gục, cần tăng khả năng sống sót
choice2_en: My hero is easily defeated, need to boost survivability
choice2_th: ฮีโร่ของฉันถูกกำจัดง่าย ต้องเพิ่มความอยู่รอด
choice2_in: Pahlawanku mudah kalah, perlu tingkatkan ketahanan
choice2_ph: Masyadong marupok ang aking bayani, dagdagan ang tibay
choice2_ma: Wira saya terlalu lemah, perlu tingkatkan daya tahan
resultDesc2: You receive a defense blessing—at the start of battle, the entire team gains a shield equal to the max HP of the team’s highest-HP hero
resultDesc2_vn: Ban nhận được phúc lành phòng ngự—khi bắt đầu trận chiến, toàn đội nhận được một lá chắn có thể hấp thụ toàn bộ sát thương, giá trị hấp thụ bằng với HP tối đa của anh hùng có HP cao nhất đội bạn
resultDesc2_en: You receive a defense blessing—at the start of battle, the entire team gains a shield equal to the max HP of the team’s highest-HP hero
resultDesc2_th: คุณได้รับพรด้านการป้องกัน—เมื่อเริ่มต่อสู้ ทีมได้รับโล่เท่ากับ HP สูงสุดของฮีโร่ที่มี HP สูงที่สุด
resultDesc2_in: Kamu menerima berkat pertahanan—di awal pertempuran, tim mendapat perisai sebesar HP maks hero tertinggi tim
resultDesc2_ph: Nakakakuha ka ng defense blessing—sa simula ng laban, ang buong team ay makakatanggap ng shield na kasing laki ng max HP ng pinakamataas na HP hero
resultDesc2_ma: Kamu terima berkat pertahanan—pada mulanya pertempuran, semua team dapat perisai sama dengan max HP wira tertinggi
choice3_th: ศัตรูแข็งแกร่งเกินไป
resultDesc3: Received the Blessing of Destruction: when the hero on our side uses the ultimate skill, all buffs on the target will be completely removed
resultDesc3_vn: Nhận được lời chúc phúc Hủy Diệt: khi anh hùng phe ta dùng kỹ năng tối thượng, sẽ xóa sạch toàn bộ buff của mục tiêu
resultDesc3_en: Received the Blessing of Destruction: when the hero on our side uses the ultimate skill, all buffs on the target will be completely removed
resultDesc3_th: ได้รับพรแห่งการทำลายล้าง: เมื่อฮีโร่ฝ่ายเราใช้สกิลอัลติเมท จะลบบัฟทั้งหมดของเป้าหมายทันที
resultDesc3_in: Menerima Berkah Kehancuran: ketika pahlawan di pihak kita menggunakan skill ultimate, semua buff pada target akan dihapuskan sepenuhnya
resultDesc3_ph: Natanggap ang Basbas ng Pagwasak: kapag ginamit ng bayani sa aming panig ang ultimate skill, lahat ng buff ng target ay tuluyang matatanggal
resultDesc3_ma: Menerima Berkat Kemusnahan: apabila wira pihak kita menggunakan kemahiran utama, semua buff pada sasaran akan dihapuskan sepenuhnya

name: Tonight’s dinner
name_th: มื้อเย็นคืนนี้
desc: You meet a Space Tower adventurer deep in thought, seemingly worried about tonight's dinner.
desc_vn: Gặp một nhà thám hiểm Tháp Không Gian đang trầm tư, cô ấy dường như đang lo lắng cho bữa tối hôm nay.
desc_en: You meet a Space Tower adventurer deep in thought, seemingly worried about tonight's dinner.
desc_th: คุณพบกับนักผจญภัยแห่งหอคอยอวกาศที่กำลังครุ่นคิด ดูเหมือนเธอจะกังวลเรื่องอาหารเย็นคืนนี้
desc_in: Bertemu petualang Menara Angkasa yang sedang melamun, tampaknya sedang memikirkan makan malam.
desc_ph: Isang Space Tower adventurer na malalim ang iniisip ang nakilala mo, tila nag-aalala sa hapunan.
desc_ma: Kamu bertemu pengembara Menara Angkasa yang termenung, kelihatan risau tentang makan malam.
choice1: Suggest she eats a rice ball
choice1_vn: Gợi ý cô ấy ăn cơm nắm
choice1_en: Suggest she eats a rice ball
choice1_th: แนะนำให้เธอกินข้าวปั้น
choice1_ph: Iminungkahing kumain siya ng rice ball
resultDesc1: She accepted your advice, went to the canteen to buy a rice ball and shared one with you
resultDesc1_vn: Cô ấy đã chấp nhận lời khuyên của bạn, đến căn tin mua cơm nắm và chia cho bạn một cái
resultDesc1_en: She accepted your advice, went to the canteen to buy a rice ball and shared one with you
resultDesc1_th: เธอยอมรับคำแนะนำของคุณ ไปซื้อข้าวปั้นที่โรงอาหารและแบ่งให้คุณ
resultDesc1_in: Dia menerima saranmu, pergi ke kantin untuk membeli onigiri dan membaginya denganmu
resultDesc1_ph: Tinanggap niya ang iyong payo, pumunta sa canteen para bumili ng onigiri at ipinamahagi sa iyo
resultDesc1_ma: Dia menerima nasihat anda, pergi ke kantin untuk membeli onigiri dan berkongsi satu dengan kamu
choice2: Not much time left, let’s just eat a lunchbox
choice2_vn: Thời gian không còn nhiều, ăn tạm cơm hộp vậy
choice2_en: Not much time left, let’s just eat a lunchbox
choice2_th: เวลาเหลือไม่มาก กินข้าวกล่องไปก่อน
choice2_in: Waktunya mepet, makan nasi kotak dulu
choice2_ph: Kaunti na lang ang oras, kainin na lang ang baon
choice2_ma: Masa semakin suntuk, makan bekal sahaja
resultDesc2: She accepts your suggestion, goes to the convenience store to buy a lunchbox, and shares one with you
resultDesc2_vn: Cô ấy chấp nhận đề xuất của bạn, đi đến cửa hàng tiện lợi mua cơm hộp và chia cho bạn một phần
resultDesc2_en: She accepts your suggestion, goes to the convenience store to buy a lunchbox, and shares one with you
resultDesc2_th: เธอยอมรับคำแนะนำ ไปซื้อข้าวกล่องที่ร้านสะดวกซื้อและแบ่งให้คุณ
resultDesc2_in: Dia menerima saranmu, pergi ke kedai serbaneka untuk beli nasi kotak dan berbagi satu untukmu
resultDesc2_ph: Tinanggap niya ang mungkahi mo, pumunta sa convenience store at bumili ng bento, pinagkain ka
resultDesc2_ma: Dia terima cadangan kamu, pergi ke kedai serbaneka beli bekal dan kongsi satu

name: Infiltration investigation?
name_th: แอบสืบสวน?
desc: A self-proclaimed patrol officer appears, asking for help investigating recent hero disappearances.
desc_vn: Trước mặt xuất hiện một người tự xưng là tuần tra viên, dường như muốn bạn hỗ trợ điều tra tình trạng mất tích bất thường của các anh hùng gần đây.
desc_en: A self-proclaimed patrol officer appears, asking for help investigating recent hero disappearances.
desc_th: เจ้าหน้าที่ลาดตระเวนอ้างตัวขอให้คุณช่วยสืบสวนการหายตัวของเหล่าฮีโร่
desc_in: Seorang petugas patroli muncul dan memintamu membantu menyelidiki hilangnya para pahlawan.
desc_ph: Isang patrol officer ang lumitaw at humihingi ng tulong upang imbestigahan ang pagkawala ng mga bayani.
desc_ma: Pegawai rondaan muncul meminta bantuan menyiasat kehilangan wira.
choice1_th: ช่วยเหลืออย่างกระตือรือร้น
resultDesc1: After you entered a room, you were ambushed— the deployed heroes’ HP decreased by 10%, but Rage increased
resultDesc1_vn: Sau khi bạn bước vào một căn phòng, bị hắn đánh lén—HP của các anh hùng ra trận giảm 10%, nhưng nộ khí tăng lên
resultDesc1_en: After you entered a room, you were ambushed— the deployed heroes’ HP decreased by 10%, but Rage increased
resultDesc1_th: หลังจากคุณเข้าไปในห้อง คุณถูกซุ่มโจมตี—HP ของฮีโร่ลดลง 10% แต่โกรธเพิ่มขึ้น
resultDesc1_in: Setelah kamu memasuki sebuah ruangan, kamu disergap—HP hero yang diturunkan turun 10%, tetapi Rage meningkat
resultDesc1_ph: Pagpasok mo sa isang silid, ikaw ay na-ambush—ang HP ng ipinadalang mga bayani ay bumaba ng 10%, ngunit tumaas ang Rage
resultDesc1_ma: Apabila anda memasuki sebuah bilik, anda disergap—HP hero yang dikerahkan menurun 10%, tetapi Rage meningkat
choice2_th: แสดงความสงสัย
resultDesc2: “You noticed... this place isn’t safe to stay long, I’m leaving first,” you feel uneasy but your heroes gain Rage
resultDesc2_vn: “Không ngờ bạn lại nhận ra… nơi này không thể ở lâu, tôi đi trước đây”, bạn cảm thấy khá khó chịu nhưng nộ khí của các anh hùng tăng lên
resultDesc2_en: “You noticed... this place isn’t safe to stay long, I’m leaving first,” you feel uneasy but your heroes gain Rage
resultDesc2_th: “คุณสังเกต... ที่นี่ไม่ปลอดภัยอยู่นาน ฉันขอไปก่อนนะ” คุณรู้สึกไม่สบายใจแต่โทสะฮีโร่เพิ่ม
resultDesc2_in: “Kamu sadar... tempat ini tak aman untuk tinggal lama, aku pergi dulu ya,” kamu merasa tidak nyaman tapi Rage hero bertambah
resultDesc2_ph: “Napansin mo… delikado itong lugar, aalis muna ako,” hindi komportable ka pero tumataas ang Rage ng hero
resultDesc2_ma: “Kamu sedar… tempat ini tak selamat lama, aku pergi dulu,” kamu rasa tak selesa tapi Rage wira meningkat

choice1_th: ช่วยเหลืออย่างกระตือรือร้น
resultDesc1: With the patrol officer, you faced a group of bandits— the deployed heroes’ HP decreased by 10%, but Rage increased
resultDesc1_vn: Cùng tuần tra viên, bạn đối đầu với một nhóm đạo tặc—HP của các anh hùng ra trận giảm 10%, nhưng nộ khí tăng lên
resultDesc1_en: With the patrol officer, you faced a group of bandits— the deployed heroes’ HP decreased by 10%, but Rage increased
resultDesc1_th: ร่วมกับเจ้าหน้าที่ลาดตระเวน คุณต่อสู้กับโจร—HP ของฮีโร่ลดลง 10% แต่โกรธเพิ่มขึ้น
resultDesc1_in: Bersama petugas patroli, kamu melawan kelompok perampok—HP hero turun 10%, tetapi Rage meningkat
resultDesc1_ph: Kasama ang patrol officer, hinarap mo ang isang grupo ng bandido—ang HP ng ipinadalang mga bayani ay bumaba ng 10%, ngunit tumaas ang Rage

choice2_th: แสดงความสงสัย
resultDesc2: “If you don't trust me, fine. Let me heal your teammates”—deployed heroes’ HP is restored
resultDesc2_vn: “Nếu bạn không tin tôi cũng đành chịu. Vậy đi, để tôi chữa trị cho đồng đội của bạn vậy”—HP của các anh hùng ra trận được hồi phục
resultDesc2_en: “If you don't trust me, fine. Let me heal your teammates”—deployed heroes’ HP is restored
resultDesc2_th: “ถ้าคุณไม่เชื่อฉัน ก็ช่าง ฉันจะรักษาพวกคุณ”—HP ฮีโร่ถูกฟื้นฟู
resultDesc2_in: “Jika kamu tak percaya padaku, biarlah. Biarkan aku menyembuhkan rekanmu”—HP hero dipulihkan
resultDesc2_ph: “Kung hindi mo ako pinaniwalaan, ayos lang. Hayaan mo akong pagalingin ang teammates mo”—HP ng hero naibalik
resultDesc2_ma: “Kalau kamu tak percaya aku pun tak apa. Biarkan aku sembuhkan pasukan kamu”—HP wira dipulihkan

name: Sweet shop
name_th: ร้านขนมหวาน
desc: You enter a pastry room, but it seems no one is around.
desc_vn: Bạn bước vào một căn phòng làm bánh, nhưng dường như không có ai ở đây.
desc_en: You enter a pastry room, but it seems no one is around.
desc_th: คุณเข้าไปในห้องทำขนม แต่ดูเหมือนไม่มีใครอยู่เลย
desc_in: Kamu masuk ke ruang membuat kue, tetapi tampaknya tidak ada orang di sana.
desc_ph: Pumasok ka sa isang pastry room, pero tila walang tao.
desc_ma: Kamu masuk bilik membuat kek, tapi nampaknya tiada orang di situ.
choice1_th: แอบกินของว่าง
resultDesc1: The deployed heroes’ HP has been recovered

resultDesc1_in: HP hero yang diturunkan telah pulih
resultDesc1_ph: Naibalik ang HP ng ipinadalang mga bayani
resultDesc1_ma: HP hero yang dikerahkan telah dipulihkan
choice2_th: ห่อกลับบ้าน
resultDesc2: Almost detected, luckily you escaped in time
resultDesc2_vn: Suýt nữa thì bị phát hiện, may mà chạy kịp
resultDesc2_en: Almost detected, luckily you escaped in time
resultDesc2_th: เกือบโดนจับได้ โชคยังดีที่หนีทัน
resultDesc2_in: Hampir ketahuan, untung kamu sempat kabur
resultDesc2_ph: Halos mahuli ka pero nakatakas ka
resultDesc2_ma: Hampir dikesan tapi kamu berjaya lari

name: Mysterious person
name_th: บุคคลลึกลับ
desc: You unexpectedly meet a suspicious person and strike up a conversation.
desc_vn: Bất ngờ gặp một người có hành tung đáng ngờ, bạn bắt chuyện với anh ta.
desc_en: You unexpectedly meet a suspicious person and strike up a conversation.
desc_th: เจอบุคคลที่ดูน่าสงสัยโดยบังเอิญ และคุณเริ่มพูดคุยกับเขา
desc_in: Kamu bertemu seseorang yang mencurigakan dan mulai berbicara dengannya.
desc_ph: Biglang may nakilala kang kahina-hinalang tao at kinausap mo siya.
desc_ma: Kamu bertemu orang yang mencurigakan dan berbual dengannya.
choice1_th: คุณคือใคร
resultDesc1: The mysterious person “poof” turned into a black shadow and quickly fled
resultDesc1_vn: Người bí ẩn “bụp” một tiếng biến thành một cái bóng đen rồi nhanh chóng bỏ trốn
resultDesc1_en: The mysterious person “poof” turned into a black shadow and quickly fled
resultDesc1_th: บุคคลลึกลับ “ปุ๊บ” กลายเป็นเงาดำแล้ววิ่งหนี
resultDesc1_in: Orang misterius "poof" berubah menjadi bayangan hitam dan segera melarikan diri
resultDesc1_ph: Ang misteryosong tao ay “poof” at naging itim na anino at mabilis na nagtakas
resultDesc1_ma: Orang misteri “poof” bertukar menjadi bayangan hitam dan segera melarikan diri
choice2_th: คุณมาจากไหน
resultDesc2: The mysterious person points the way; you follow and find a strange device—activate and receive 50 points and some gold
resultDesc2_vn: Người bí ẩn chỉ tay về một hướng, bạn đi theo và phát hiện một thiết bị kỳ lạ—kích hoạt và nhận được 50 điểm thưởng cùng một ít vàng
resultDesc2_en: The mysterious person points the way; you follow and find a strange device—activate and receive 50 points and some gold
resultDesc2_th: บุคคลลึกลับชี้ทาง คุณตามและพบอุปกรณ์—เปิดใช้งานแล้วได้รับ 50 คะแนนและทอง
resultDesc2_in: Orang misterius menunjuk jalan; kamu mengikutinya dan menemukan perangkat aneh—aktifkan dan dapatkan 50 poin dan emas
resultDesc2_ph: Ang misteryosong tao ay tumuro sa daan; sinundan mo at nahanap ang device—activate at makakuha ka ng 50 puntos at ginto
resultDesc2_ma: Orang misteri tunjuk jalan; kamu ikut dan jumpa alat pelik—aktif dan dapat 50 mata dan emas
choice3_th: คุณจะไปที่ไหน
resultDesc3: The mysterious person seems unwilling to say anything, taking out a small pouch from their bag and giving it to you
resultDesc3_vn: Người bí ẩn dường như không muốn nói gì, lấy ra một túi nhỏ từ trong túi đưa cho bạn
resultDesc3_en: The mysterious person seems unwilling to say anything, taking out a small pouch from their bag and giving it to you
resultDesc3_th: บุคคลปริศนาดูเหมือนไม่ต้องการพูดอะไร หยิบถุงเล็กๆ ออกจากกระเป๋าแล้วให้กับคุณ
resultDesc3_in: Orang misterius tampaknya tidak ingin mengatakan apa-apa, mengeluarkan sebuah kantong kecil dari tasnya dan memberikannya kepada Anda
resultDesc3_ph: Ang taong misteryoso ay tila ayaw magsalita, kumuha ng maliit na supot mula sa bag at ibinigay sa iyo
resultDesc3_ma: Orang misteri nampaknya tidak mahu berkata apa-apa, mengeluarkan satu beg kecil dari dalam beg dan memberikannya kepada anda

resultDesc1_en: The mysterious person pointed in one direction, you followed and discovered a strange device— after activating it, you received an additional 50 points and some gold

resultDesc3_in: Orang misterius “pop” berubah menjadi bayangan lalu dengan cepat melarikan diri
